sp006.author: Nikola Veljković
sp006.description: Kobac (Accipiter nisus) je ptica iz reda orlova i jastrebova (Accipitriformes). U periodu gnežđenja je prisutan u svim regionima Srbije, osim u obešumljenim delovima Vojvodine. Gnezdi se u šumama i mozaičnim staništima, od nizija do gornje šumske granice, a sve češće se beleži i u većim parkovskim površinama u naseljima. Van perioda gnežđenja se viđa širom Srbije. Smatra se da brojnost populacije

sp248.title: File:Osičar, mužjak (Pernis apivorus); European Honey Buzzard, male.jpg
sp248.author: Nikola Veljković
sp248.description: Osičar (Pernis apivorus) je ptica selica iz reda orlova i jastrebova (Accipitriformes). Kao gnezdarica je prilično ravnomerno rasprostranjen u svim regionima Srbije, osim u Vojvodini gde odsustvuje u obešumljenim područjima. Naseljava pobrđe i brdsko-planinske mozaične predele sa većim šumskim kompleksima. U periodu seobe se viđa širom Srbije (Šćiban i sar., 2015).

sp248.title: File:Pernis apivorus - osičar 1.jpg

sp250.title: File:A Pallid Harrier Adult Male (50562907412).jpg
sp250.author: Hari K Patibanda
sp250.description: We accidentally stumbled upon a communal roosting place of harriers and there were a big number of them in one place. The males usually having white in the species of Montagu, Pallid and Pied are quite beautiful and easily visible. This one is a large male judging by the size of it. Thanks in advance for your views and feedback. Much appreciated.

sp250.title: File:A Pallid Harrier Surveying the roosting place (50566471236).jpg
sp250.author: Hari K Patibanda
sp250.description: This male - a fully grown adult - judging by the size - was surveying the 2 acre field full of tall grass to roost. He made several rounds and think he found several of his favorite places occupied. He made a number of circles and finally settled. This is frontal shot, denoised and sharpened - what do you think of it? Thanks in advance for your views and feedback. Much appreciated.

sp250.title: File:A Pallid Harrier - Adult male roosting just after sunset (50573183712).jpg
sp250.author: Hari K Patibanda
sp250.description: A cautious Harrier roosting for the night amongst a group of 10 other harriers. The birds do a quick survey of their roosting area to check for predators and mostly choose the grassy area to roost. The logic maybe to check for predators.
